prompt: What are the primary manufacturing components of a Single-use bioreactor? List each component on its own line.
components: Mixing system (e.g., rocking platform or impeller)
Gas supply system (sparger and gas lines)
Sensors and probes (pH, dissolved oxygen, temperature)
Ports and connectors (for sampling, inoculation, and addition of media)
Control unit (for monitoring and regulating parameters)
